newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech authorities to investigate bank's fund role.
newsitem.headline: Czech authorities to investigate bank's fund role.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) said on Tuesday it had agreed with the Finance Ministry on a further investigation of Plzenska Banka a.s., for its connection with an alleged fraud at investment company CS Fond.

"The control, which will be performed by representatives of the Finance Ministry's Securities Bureau and banking supervisors of the CNB will be aimed at proceedings of Plzenska during performing the function of a depository of CS Fond a.s. mutual funds," the CNB said in a statement.
Local media have reported that fund managers CS Fond have recently channelled three funds' assets worth over 1.25 billion crowns out of the country.
The Finance Ministry placed the funds under forced administration last week due to its plunging asset value and a fund move to replace its management without ministry approval.
